# 3 bed detached house for sale

> SITUATION: The property is situated only five miles from the village of Oughterard, on a lovely part of the Glann Road, just two miles from the Hill of Doon, and in one of the most sought after locations in Connemara. Oughterard is a charming village on the shores of Lough Corrib - the internationally renowned wild brown trout fishery.

- Lokalita: An Sean Scoil, Farravaun, Oughterard
